reports.fhlValidUsersTotalTip: Distinct users who completed the intro and onboarding milestones.
reports.fhlActiveUsersTotalTip: Distinct users who reached the valid interaction threshold in the selected range.
reports.fhlAvgDailyInteractionsTip: Total interaction events divided by the number of calendar days in the selected range.
reports.fhlActivityHint: Time trend for visits, registrations, valid users, active users, and interactions.
reports.fhlRegistrationHint: New registrations by selected granularity with the PC / mobile registration mix.
